spiritgiven.comments:
We did talk to the captains about the spirit before the game and they agreed to concern about the contact and avoid body check as much as they can and only do it in case to agree  with the matchup.
But we felt they continued doing it constantly, we also have to improve making the calls
It was a really good game, good spirit, they had some issues with their spirit but they kept a very good attitude during the game.
Good spirit game but it was difficult to explain the rules, they don't have the mood to understand and learn

spiritreceived.comments: Throughout the whole game the fair-mindedness was always amazing, despite the language barrier the communication was good with assistance from translators (coaches, players). During halftime there was a spirit captain talk and the things mentioned there were improved a lot in the second half. And even though it was a tight game we thought the attitude towards us and towards themselves was always respectful.
Slight issue with double team calling but was good in the second half. Were very friendly even with the language barrier for some players.

Before the game, colombia mentioned about not wanting body contact and no hand checking. Yet the game had several dangerous contact plays and unnecessary bids, resulting in a lot of contacts, especially the ones in the air. One more thing we want to mention is the fast counts. We pointed it out several times but yet nothing was done about it. Apart from that we really enjoyed the high intensity fight from both sides, and we would like to thank colombia for the great game!

The spirit note does not match what we said in the spirit huddle, we’re sorry for that, our spirit captain did not recap what we said between us.
What we need to remember of this game is that the communication was too long and colombians heated up early on each calls.
Other wise a really nice game on the side lines and little to no body contact throughout each lay out
Some dangerous or risky plays, so a 1 in that category. All other aspects were good.

Sometimes felt like players were unwilling to accept perspectives that went against them however the communication during calls was excellent - we would probably suggest that your team should refresh their knowledge of the fast count rules and adjust the speed at which you stall
very spiritual game. they retracted some foul calls with absolutely great attitudes. they also were very willing to communicate about any issues friendly. great game. the layouts were wild and clean.
